messages:
maria: Heads-up: noticed ~12% of traces missing the parent span after yesterday's collector config change. Saw it in the by-service dashboards; span count for frontend->router reduced but child spans still present.

sam: Which collector change? any deploy logs?

maria: Deploy shows otel-collector:config v2.4.0 rolled at 1918722000 (deploy-bot posted). The only notable tweak was enabling "coalesce_export_batches": true and dropping max_batch_delay_ms from 10 -> 1 in exporter config.

kevin: ugh. coalescing + aggressive delay can clip parent if batching keying collides? can you paste exporter logs that show spans being exported vs dropped?

maria: Pasting a trimmed excerpt from the collector stdout where we see an export chunk that lacks the parent ID even though the app logs the parent span start: 

```
2026-03-19T18:41:12Z INFO span-exporter batching send size=48 payload_spans=47
2026-03-19T18:41:12Z DEBUG dropped_span parent_id_missing count=2 reason=serialization
2026-03-19T18:41:12Z INFO span-exporter send_ok
```

sam: "parent_id_missing" in the collector logs is a strong signal. Could be an early eviction during coalesce or a race where parent arrives in a different batch than children and then the parent is deduped/trimmed by size limits.

nico: We also saw exporter queue pressure on metrics: exporter_queue_length spiked to ~800 for secs after the change. If the exporter drops items when queue full, children could be shipped but parent dropped if parent hit a collector-side sample/ttl.

jen: Repro checklist: 1) capture raw eventdata at app side (we have app-side span dumps) 2) tail collector exporter payloads (we can enable verbose logging) 3) run integration with artificial high concurrency. I can run a canary.

maria: I ran a local repro with load ~200rps for 2m and reproduced missing parent on ~11%. Commands used: 

```
# reproduce
hey -n 500 -c 50 http://staging-router.local/hit
# then check app spans
jq '.spans | map(select(.name=="parent")) | length' traces.json
```

sam: Can you also run instrumented collector with `--metrics-level debug`? We need to see exporter batching behavior and queue evictions.

kevin: There's a known issue in otel-collector 0.57 where coalesce+small-delay could cause partial payload assembly leading to parent-less batches if the span ordering isn't stable. We thought the 2.4.0 packaging had the fix but maybe our build used the older vendored lib.

maria: Confirmed: the collector binary at /opt/otel/bin has `otelcol version: 0.56.3` inside the configmap. So the config change rolled but the binary didn't. That explains it.

deploy-bot: Deploy 1918722000 succeeded: otel-collector-configmap:v2.4.0 applied to cluster prod-a.

nico: Okay, mitigation options: 1) rollback the config change (disable coalesce / restore max_batch_delay_ms=10) 2) replace collector binary with the fixed 0.57+ build 3) bump exporter queue size and add metric alert for dropped_span. Short-term rollback is fastest.

maria: Agreed. Ops — can you roll the config back and pin to previous config until we have verified a fixed binary?

ops: Rolling back config now to otel-collector-configmap:v2.3.7 on prod-a. I'll watch spans and post back in 5m.

kevin: Also add immediate dashboard panels: "exporter dropped_span_count", "exporter_queue_length", and an alert on dropped_span_count > 1/min per cluster. We should also add a regression test in rollout pipeline that simulates coalesced batches with parent/child ordering.

ops: rollback completed at 1918723350. Initial check: span ingestion rate back to expected, parent-span presence in sample traces looks OK.

maria: Verified — sampled traces from frontend now include parent span again. Child counts match upstream. Thanks.

sam: Action items: 
- kevin: confirm fixed collector binary and coordinate safe upgrade (owner)
- jen: add canary test that checks parent/child correlation under load (owner)
- devex: add a note in rollout docs about exporter coalesce risks (owner: maria)
- ops: add alert for dropped_span_count and exporter_queue_length (owner)

kevin: I'll track collector issue and propose upgrade plan. If we can't get a fixed binary quickly, we'll keep coalesce disabled by default in config.

maria: Thanks everyone. Adding follow-up ticket in eng-platform backlog: "investigate coalesce-induced span loss + rollout safeguard" and assigning to kevin.

nico: One more thought — add unit tests that serialize out-of-order parent/child pairs and verify aggregation doesn't lose parent. Might catch future regressions.

maria: Good call. I'll include test suggestion in the ticket. Closing thread once ticket exists.

ops: Ticket created: PLAT-1229. Closing loop: will monitor for 24h and escalate if recurrence. :thumbsup:
